<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks at 134.30, 131.90, 128.20 (two signals), and 127.40 (two signals) fall within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–160 ppm). Counting these gives six aromatic carbon signals, corresponding to six aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
